source.title: 121. Milosrđe Božje - Kako graditi Hram Božji?

summary.title_hr: 121. Milosrđe Božje - Kako graditi Hram Božji?
summary.abstract_hr: Epizoda vjerskog podcasta Ora et Labora iz Međugorja počinje molitvama: zaštitnom molitvom, molitvom svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu, posvetom Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu, krunicom Božjega milosrđa s litanijama te Gospinom krunicom. Slijedi tumačenje Poslanice Efežanima, Psalma i Evanđelja po Luki (Lk 6,12-19) o izboru dvanaestorice apostola. Voditelj tumači da se Crkva kao duhovni hram gradi rušenjem sotoninih utvrda u srcima ljudi molitvom, postom i ljubavlju. Pritom treba osuđivati grijeh, a ne grešnika. Govoreći o izboru apostola, ističe da Bog u molitvi pokazuje tko treba služiti te da legitimitet daju rezultati, odnosno obraćenja. Spominje i političke događaje u Srbiji, koje povezuje sa završetkom 40-dnevnog posta protiv duhova rata. Na kraju najavljuje promocije po Hrvatskoj i BiH, poziva na učlanjenje i donacije te na molitvu krunice.
key_topics: krunica božjega milosrđa i gospina krunica
post i molitva protiv duhova rata
izbor apostola i legitimitet kroz rezultate
key_points: Prema voditelju, sveti Pavao u Poslanici Efežanima piše o gradnji Crkve kao duhovnog hrama. Ta je Crkva u prvim kršćanskim vremenima bila jedinstvena, a danas je razjedinjena. Pravoslavne crkve, poput ruske i srpske, opisuje kao nacionalne i u službi politike.

Pad Vučića s vlasti, kojega naziva ratnim huškačem, voditelj povezuje sa završetkom 40-dnevnog posta protiv duhova rata i s Gospinom porukom da post može zaustaviti ratove. Upozorava da to nije konačna pobjeda i da treba ustrajati u molitvi i postu.

Crkva se gradi rušenjem sotoninih utvrda u srcima ljudi, kao što su mržnja, želja za ratom, preljub, krađa, gramzivost i sebičnost. Voditelj tvrdi da više vrijedi pet obraćenih duša nego pet milijuna pregleda nekog sadržaja.

Zlo i grijeh treba prokazivati na primjeren način, a ne upirati prstom u osobe ili institucije. Treba biti strog prema grijehu, a blag prema grešniku, kao što je Isus osudio grijeh, ali ne i ženu preljubnicu. Voditelj se i sam javno ispričao za svoje pogreške.
Isus je noć proveo u molitvi i postu prije izbora apostola. Voditelj iz toga zaključuje da nitko ne bi smio preuzeti položaj u hijerarhiji ako ga Bog prije toga nije potvrdio.

Voditelj ističe da legitimitet daju rezultati, kao u sportu ili poduzetništvu. Za kršćanina su ti rezultati obraćeni ljudi i djela za Boga. Navodi svjedočanstvo žene koja se boji da će u knjizi njezina života stajati prazna stranica jer je samo primala.
Đavao, prema voditelju, nastoji srušiti Crkvu na zemlji. Budući da Božja riječ prožima sva područja života, pa i politiku, vjernici se moraju opredijeliti i braniti Crkvu.
key_topics_en: Chaplet of Divine Mercy and Our Lady's Rosary
building the Church as a spiritual temple
fasting and prayer against spirits of war
condemning the sin, not the sinner
choice of the apostles and legitimacy through results
key_points_en: According to the host, Saint Paul in the Epistle to the Ephesians writes about building the Church as a spiritual temple. That Church was united in early Christian times, whereas today it is divided. He describes Orthodox churches, such as the Russian and Serbian ones, as national and in the service of politics.

The host links the fall of Vučić from power, whom he calls a warmonger, to the end of the 40-day fast against spirits of war and to Our Lady's message that fasting can stop wars. He warns that this is not the final victory and that one must persevere in prayer and fasting.

The Church is built by tearing down Satan's strongholds in people's hearts, such as hatred, desire for war, adultery, theft, greed, and selfishness. The host claims that five converted souls are worth more than five million views of some content.

Evil and sin should be exposed in an appropriate way, rather than pointing fingers at individuals or institutions. One should be strict toward sin and gentle toward the sinner, just as Jesus condemned sin, but not the adulterous woman. The host himself publicly apologized for his mistakes.
Jesus spent the night in prayer and fasting before choosing the apostles. The host concludes from this that no one should assume a position in the hierarchy if God has not previously confirmed them.

The host emphasizes that legitimacy is given by results, as in sports or entrepreneurship. For a Christian, those results are converted people and deeds for God. He cites the testimony of a woman who fears that an empty page will stand in the book of her life because she only received.
According to the host, the devil seeks to overthrow the Church on earth. Since the word of God permeates all areas of life, including politics, believers must take a stand and defend the Church.
summary.title_en: 121. God's Mercy - How to Build the Temple of God?
summary.abstract_en: An episode of the religious podcast Ora et Labora from Međugorje begins with prayers: a protection prayer, a prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel, a consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary, the Chaplet of Divine Mercy with litanies, and Our Lady's Rosary. This is followed by an interpretation of the Epistle to the Ephesians, the Psalm, and the Gospel according to Luke (Lk 6:12-19) on the choice of the twelve apostles. The host explains that the Church as a spiritual temple is built by tearing down Satan's strongholds in the hearts of people through prayer, fasting, and love. In doing so, one should condemn the sin, not the sinner. Speaking about the choice of the apostles, he emphasizes that God shows in prayer who should serve and that legitimacy is given by results, namely conversions. He also mentions political events in Serbia, which he connects with the end of a 40-day fast against spirits of war. In the end, he announces promotional events across Croatia and BiH, invites people to join and donate, and calls for praying the Rosary.
